description: Canadian bank numbers: institution (3 digits), transit (5 digits) and account (7 to 12 digits) numbers, alone or read together. They carry no check digit, so a run of 3 or more digits counts only with a bank word (English: bank, branch, transit, institution, account; French: banque, bancaire, succursale, compte, folio; each also in the plural) among the last 4 words before it, and none of those words may be before an earlier digit run. Digits may be spoken as digit words in English or French. Each case lists the exact substrings a redactor must find, in order. Every number is made up.
